error-no-profiles.description: No POS Profile for the user: red alert, inputs and Open button disabled.

error-no-permission.description: User cannot create or submit an opening entry: red alert with lock icon.

warning-previous-day.description: Previous day not closed: orange alert, Open button disabled.

warning-main-cashier.description: Multi-cashier: main cashier has not opened yet, orange alert.

zero-balance-confirm.description: All amounts zero after the first press: orange warning and the button reads Confirm & Open.

retry-actions.description: Source footer also renders Retry and Back to Dashboard buttons beside the primary action (POSOpeningScreen always renders all three); shown as a variant.

submitting.description: Opening in progress: spinner icon and Opening... label, actions disabled.

submit-error.description: Server error shown in a red box above the actions.

profile-select.description: More than one allowed profile: POS Profile select replaces the profile badge.

disabled.reason: shown as the blocked variants where the action buttons and inputs are disabled

error.reason: not applicable: this component has no distinct error variant

loading.reason: the submitting variant covers the loading state

empty.reason: amounts left at zero are the zero-balance variant
